name: Sparktinkerer
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Built it in a cave! With a box of asteroid scraps!

name: Blast Beetle
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: It's not a bug — well, TECHNICALLY it IS a bug, but the explosion is a FEATURE.

name: Fuse Lighter
cardText: DEPLOY: Give a friendly Mech LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: She doesn't ask what the fuse is connected to. That's what makes her employee of the month.

name: Cobalt Capacitor
cardText: Deal 2 damage. If the target dies, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Step 1: Charge it. Step 2: Throw it. Step 3: There is no Step 3. You're already running.

name: Scrap Grenade
cardText: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavorText: Gnomish recycling: turn yesterday's trash into today's shrapnel.

name: Boom Cog
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Tick. Tick. Tick. Tick. SURPRISE! ...Why is nobody ever surprised?

name: Tinker's Assistant
cardText: LAST WORDS: Add a random 1-cost Mech to your hand.
flavorText: Fetch me the 9/16ths cosmic wrench! No, the OTHER 9/16ths cosmic wrench! The one that's on fire!

name: Nebula Welder
cardText: GUARDIAN. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Welds hulls with star-stuff. Three OSHA violations per spark. Worth it.

name: Volatile Payload
cardText: Give a friendly minion LAST WORDS: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Careful, it's— actually, you know what, just don't be near it.

name: Assembly Line
cardText: Summon two 1/1 Spark-Bots with LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Two for the price of two. Both explode free of charge! Volume discounts on volume explosions!

name: Galactic Sapper
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to two random enemies.
flavorText: Plants demolition charges on planets. Yes, WHOLE planets. The paperwork is surprisingly short.

name: Cogwork Detonator
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal damage equal to this minion's Attack to a random enemy.
flavorText: Gnomish engineering rule #1: the bigger they build 'em, the louder they go.

name: Wrench Gnome
cardText: DEPLOY: Give a friendly Mech +2 Attack.
flavorText: Percussive maintenance is a 400-year gnomish tradition. You hit it till it works or catches fire.

name: Plasma Cutter
cardText: Deal 4 damage. If the target is a Mech, deal 6 instead.
flavorText: Cuts through hull plating like cosmic butter. Don't ask what cosmic butter is.

name: Containment Breach
cardText: Destroy a friendly Mech. Trigger its LAST WORDS twice.
flavorText: Safety Protocol 7: There IS no Safety Protocol 7. That's the protocol.

name: Salvage Crawler
cardText: SALVAGE. (LAST WORDS: Draw a card.)
flavorText: One gnome's wreckage is another gnome's Wednesday. And Thursday. Most days, really.

name: Gyro Sentinel
cardText: BARRIER.
flavorText: Spins at 40,000 RPM. Deflects lasers, plasma bolts, AND constructive criticism.

name: Rocket Rat
cardText: SWIFT. LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: It's a rat! With rockets! What could possibly— oh it's already exploded.

name: Star-Smelter
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 3 damage split randomly among all enemies.
flavorText: Forged IN a star. Explodes LIKE a star. The gnomes consider this peak engineering.

name: Turret Deployer
cardText: DEPLOY: Summon a 2/2 Boom Turret with LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Some assembly required. Disassembly is automatic. Usually involuntary.

name: Power Core
cardText: Draw 2 cards. If you control a Mech, draw 3 instead.
flavorText: It's NOT a battery. It's a POWER CORE. The distinction matters for insurance purposes.

name: Overcharge
cardText: Give a Mech +3 Attack and SWIFT this turn. When it dies this turn, trigger its LAST WORDS twice.
flavorText: MAXIMUM POWER! MAXIMUM LIABILITY! MAXIMUM FUN! ...Minimum survivors.

name: Iron Rampart
cardText: GUARDIAN. UPGRADE (2): Gain +3/+3.
flavorText: They shall not pass. Mostly because it's blocking the airlock AND it might explode.

name: Chrome Charger
cardText: BLITZ. LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Zero to lightspeed in zero seconds. Stopping takes... significantly longer.

name: Cranky Mechanic
cardText: DEPLOY: Give all friendly Mechs LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Touch my wrench and I'll rig you to blow. Touch my lunch and I'll rig EVERYTHING to blow.

name: Furnace Golem
cardText: UPGRADE (2): Gain BARRIER and +2/+2.
flavorText: Runs on compressed starfire. Handle with care. Or don't. The gnomes stopped caring centuries ago.

name: Munitions Stockpile
cardText: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions. Deal 1 more for each friendly minion with LAST WORDS.
flavorText: Inventory: full. Safety inspector: still missing. Morale: through the roof. (The roof is also missing.)

name: Exhaust Cannon
cardText: Deal 4 damage to all enemies. Deal 2 more for each Mech you control.
flavorText: Fire EVERYTHING. Then fire the things that fire everything. Then fire the guy who didn't fire fast enough.

name: Bronze Colossus
cardText: GUARDIAN. UPGRADE (3): Gain DOUBLE STRIKE.
flavorText: Big. Bronze. Stuffed with enough ordnance to crack a moon. Beautiful.

name: War Machine
cardText: SWIFT. LAST WORDS: Deal 4 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: Diplomacy was never an option. Neither was 'surviving in the same star system.'

name: Detonation Specialist
cardText: Your LAST WORDS effects deal 2 more damage.
flavorText: PhD in Applied Explosions from the Galactic Institute of Kaboom. Minor in Running Away.

name: Gear Master
cardText: Your Mechs cost (1) less and have +1 Attack.
flavorText: He doesn't build Mechs. He raises them. With love. And several thousand volts.

name: Chain Reaction Module
cardText: Whenever a friendly minion's LAST WORDS deals damage, deal 1 damage to another random enemy.
flavorText: Action → Reaction → Catastrophe → Invoice.

name: Reclamation Bay
cardText: Whenever a friendly Mech dies, add a copy of it to your hand. It costs (1) more.
flavorText: Nothing stays dead on Mechronis. It just gets a higher price tag and a fresh coat of soot.

name: Chromatic Alloy
cardText: Give a Mech +1/+1 for each other Mech you control.
flavorText: Strength in numbers. Explosions in BIGGER numbers.

name: Emergency Protocol
cardText: Give all friendly Mechs BARRIER and +2 Health.
flavorText: SHIELDS UP! Oh wait, those are bombs. BOMBS UP! Wait, that's worse!

name: Overclocked Engine
cardText: DOUBLE STRIKE. UPGRADE (3): Gain +3 Attack.
flavorText: The warranty voided itself. Out of fear. The warranty ITSELF was afraid.

name: Tesla Coil
cardText: End of Turn: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy for each Mech you control.
flavorText: Zap. ZAP. ZAP ZAP ZAP. The gnomes left the dial at 'maximum fun.'

name: Salvage Operative
cardText: SALVAGE. LAST WORDS: Summon a 3/3 Boom-Bot with LAST WORDS: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Dies, draws, deploys, detonates. The gnomish circle of life.

name: Galvanize
cardText: Give all friendly Mechs +3/+3 and SWIFT.
flavorText: LET'S! GO! BLOW! STUFF! UP!

name: Titan Assembler
cardText: DEPLOY: Summon a copy of a random friendly Mech.
flavorText: CTRL+C, CTRL+V, CTRL+KABOOM. Standard gnomish keyboard shortcut.

name: Disassemble
cardText: Destroy a minion. If it was a Mech, trigger all friendly LAST WORDS effects.
flavorText: Deconstructive criticism. Heavy emphasis on the 'destructive.'

name: Neutron Bomb
cardText: Destroy ALL minions. Trigger all friendly LAST WORDS effects.
flavorText: When in doubt, nuke from orbit. Gnomish proverb. Also gnomish Tuesday.

name: Mech Fabricator
cardText: DEPLOY: Fill your hand with 1/1 Spark-Bots that cost (0). They have LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Loading... loading... ARMING... arming... Done! Your hand is now a minefield! You're welcome!

name: Ironclad Behemoth
cardText: GUARDIAN. BARRIER.
flavorText: The immovable object. Also rigged to explode if you make eye contact.

name: Goblin Sapper Squad
cardText: DEPLOY: Summon two 1/1 Goblin Sappers with LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Three gnomes. Six sticks of dynamite. Zero plan.

name: Retrofit
cardText: Give a friendly Mech +0/+3 and LAST WORDS: Deal damage equal to this minion's Health to a random enemy.
flavorText: New armor, new purpose, new blast radius.

name: Cosmic Junkyard
cardText: Whenever a friendly Mech dies, summon a 1/1 Spark-Bot with LAST WORDS: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: Nothing goes to waste. Everything goes to BOOM.

name: Aftershock Plating
cardText: Give a friendly Mech +2/+2. Its LAST WORDS trigger an additional time.
flavorText: Built-in redundancy. The explosion has a backup explosion.

name: Orbital Bombardier
cardText: DEPLOY: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. LAST WORDS: Deal 3 damage to two random enemies.
flavorText: Arrives loud. Leaves louder. The neighbors have filed 7,000 complaints.

name: NITROGLYCOGNOME
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy and 2 damage to your hero.
flavorText: He's not brave. He just forgot which pocket the detonator was in. Every. Single. Time.

name: ASTRAL ANVIL
cardText: Your Mechs have +1/+1 and their LAST WORDS deal double damage.
flavorText: Forged from a dying star by a gnome who asked 'what if we made the explosions TWICE as big?' and nobody stopped him.

name: DOOMSDAY PROTOCOL
cardText: Destroy all friendly Mechs. Trigger each of their LAST WORDS three times.
flavorText: In case of emergency: CAUSE BIGGER EMERGENCIES. In case of bigger emergencies: see page 1.

name: COSMIC REASSEMBLER
cardText: LAST WORDS: Resummon this minion with -1/-1. (Minimum 1/1. Retains LAST WORDS.)
flavorText: You can't kill it. You CAN annoy it. It explodes, rebuilds, explodes, rebuilds. It's having the time of its life.

name: CLUSTER BOMB ARRAY
cardText: Whenever a friendly Mech dies, deal 3 damage split randomly among all enemies.
flavorText: For every action, there is an equal and opposite explosion. This is not Newton's law. This is BETTER than Newton's law.

name: GNOMECHANIC PRIME
cardText: Whenever a friendly minion's LAST WORDS triggers, trigger it again. LAST WORDS: Deal 5 damage split randomly among all enemies.
flavorText: Chief Engineer. Chief Demolitionist. She doesn't see a difference and honestly neither do we.

name: THE INFINITY COIL
cardText: End of Turn: Summon a 2/2 Spark-Bot with LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. Your Mechs cost (1) less.
flavorText: Infinite bots. Infinite explosions. Infinite fun. The gnomish definition of 'sustainable energy.'

name: CONSTRUCTOR SUPREME
cardText: DEPLOY: Transform all Mechs in your hand and deck into 8/8s. Give them LAST WORDS: Deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: She doesn't build machines. She builds LEGACIES. Loud, exploding legacies that leave craters.

name: ADMIRAL BOOMSWORTH III
cardText: DEPLOY: Give ALL friendly minions LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy. Your LAST WORDS effects trigger twice.
flavorText: His middle name is literally 'Boom.' His first name is also 'Boom.' The third of his name. Long may he detonate.

name: THE GRAND DETONATOR
cardText: BLITZ. LAST WORDS: Deal 15 damage split randomly among all enemies.
flavorText: The gnomes' final argument. It has never lost a debate. Mostly because there's nobody left to disagree.
